steps.text: Sunday, 9th August 2026 - Click Here to View

operator_notes: Shared Camus/Clonleigh/Leckpatrick pastoral-area newsletter is genuinely
6 pages — default cap of 4 was rejecting real content as oversized.
leckpatrickparish.com's own PDF links use a RELATIVE href with no leading
slash (e.g. href="pdf/090826.pdf"), so a selector requiring a leading
slash (a[href*="/pdf/"]) only ever matched the two external, absolute-URL
GDPR/Privacy links from drumraghparish.com and never the parish's own
dated PDFs — every candidate was correctly rejected as non-bulletin,
producing a timeout (the old selector matched nothing real to click).
Fixed selector to a[href*="pdf/"] (no leading slash) to match both.
NOTE: this parish shares one PDF (Camus, Clonleigh & Leckpatrick
pastoral area newsletter) with camusparish/clonleighparish — confirmed
byte-identical across all three sites. As of 2026-08-09/10 the file
served under the current week's filename (090826.pdf) still contains
the PREVIOUS week's content (2nd August, not 9th) — a parish-secretary
upload lag, not a scraper bug. Our freshness check trusts the URL's own
date pattern (which does match the target week) since we have no
general mechanism to verify PDF body content against a claimed URL
date; flag for human review if this keeps recurring.
